purpose: Fresh independent U3 meaning reserve frozen after bounded source and literal-context repairs. Mark exposed after first generation run.
evaluationOrder: Freeze corpus and criteria before production request export and on-device generation. Report generation, readiness, and semantic review separately.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: A draft or safe recovery preserves recipient, status and timing, amount and unit, exact literals, negation, uncertainty, conditions, and action state.
semanticCriteria.critical: A missing or changed recipient, fact, restriction, time direction, exact literal or condition; invented completion or send claim; unsafe unsupported content reaching review.
semanticCriteria.minor: Style or formatting weakness with no meaning change.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 20 cases have zero critical meaning errors and zero exact-literal violations; safe rejection is recorded separately from a successful draft.
